LESSON: READING 15.4.1 POETRY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.4: Reading 15.4.1 Poetry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 15.4.1 Poetry, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why would you use a poem instead of a story to pass information? 2. What makes a poem interesting to read?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the subject matter of a poem

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 15.4.1 Poetry in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. analyse ideas in the poem

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 15.4.1 Poetry in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. reiterate the role of poetry in passing information.  Collaborate with peers to recite poems for enjoyment and outline the subject matter, Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use an appropriate functional part of the body or use appropriate assistive devices during presentations. Allow more time for learners with speech difficulties to express their views. 1. Why would you use a poem instead of a story to pass information? 2. What makes a poem interesting to read? 3. Create a conducive environment and adequate space for learners with mobility difficulties and ensure safety for all learners as they 155 perform the activity. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 15.4.1 Poetry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Problem Solving: finding extra information as learners search online and offline for ways of determining ideas in a poem

 Critical thinking: following simple instructions as learners dramatise a poem displaying ideas generated from it using

placards and record their performances

Values:
Peace: enhanced as learners share their findings and provide positive feedback.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Life Skills Education: decision making enhanced as learners evaluate which ideas a poem conveys.

Link to other subjects:

Poetry recitation and performance of poems relates to the learning of performance techniques in Kiswahili and Creative Arts.
